definitions.explanation: A romantic relationship between two people.

examples.english: To have a wide circle of friends.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{交際|こうさい}している。
{彼|かれ}らは3{年間|ねんかん}{交際|こうさい}した{後|あと}、{先月|せんげつ}{結婚|けっこん}した。
examples.english: After dating for three years, they got married last month.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}の{人|ひと}たちとの{交際|こうさい}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: I value my social relationships with the neighbors.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}から{交際|こうさい}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}まれて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised when a friend asked me out.

notes:
{交際|こうさい} covers both general social relationships and romantic dating, depending on context.

SENSE 1 — SOCIALIZING:
Refers to maintaining relationships with others in a social or professional context.
- {交際|こうさい}が{広|ひろ}い: to have a wide social circle
- {交際|こうさい}が{狭|せま}い: to have a narrow social circle
- {交際|こうさい}{費|ひ}: entertainment/socializing expenses

SENSE 2 — DATING:
Refers to a romantic relationship. This is the more common meaning in everyday conversation.
- {交際|こうさい}する: to date, to go out with
- {交際|こうさい}{相手|あいて}: romantic partner
- {交際|こうさい}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to ask someone out
- {交際|こうさい}{期間|きかん}: length of relationship

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, {付|つ}き{合|あ}う is more common for "dating." {交際|こうさい} is preferred in news, formal announcements, and written contexts.
